text: Handling deadlines well begins with good time management. First, make a realistic plan and break large tasks into smaller steps. Next, prioritise your work: focus on the most important tasks first, because not everything is equally urgent. Scope management is also essential — if a project grows too big, discuss with your team to reduce it to what is truly necessary. Finally, communicate clearly. Tell colleagues or your manager early if you think a deadline is at risk, rather than waiting until the last minute. With planning, clear priorities and honest communication, deadlines become much easier to manage.
